The simplicity of this dish lets the flavor of its ingredients shine.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Plain Crepes can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Fresh Milk]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Tabantha Wheat]], a [[Bird Egg]], and [[Goat Butter]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. When eaten, they will restore some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. Because this dish is so simple, the flavor of the ingredients is able to shine. Since Plain Crepes require five ingredients to make, no variations of them exist. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Honey Crepe * Meal * Wildberry Crepe }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK }}
